summary: Build practical HS, valuation, origin, and declaration-control skills in a five-day course. Explore the outline and check your fit.
lede: Customs training helps trade professionals review declarations, classify goods, assess customs value, and check shipment evidence. Coverage includes origin documents, Incoterms, shipment-document checks, customs risk indicators, and digital filing data quality. Practical exercises include calculating customs value, creating review checklists, and using spreadsheet analysis to support consistent declaration controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, or oversee customs declarations and cross-border trade controls.
modules: Rules of Origin and Preference Claims
Customs Risk and WCO SAFE Framework
WCO Data Model and Digital Customs
prerequisites: Working knowledge of import-export workflows or responsibility for customs, shipping, trade documentation, or supply-chain compliance is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted HS suggestions and automated declaration checks receive conceptual coverage; practical exercises use document review and spreadsheet analysis.
